title: Paid but Undelivered: Demanding Accountability from TDOC and GTL Connect (Office of the Governor)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Tennessee Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

TDOC and GTL Connect must explain why paid messages to Tony Von Carruthers are rejected or left pending, potentially blocking important information and communication with loved ones. We have documentation showing approved, rejected, and pending messages.

Who makes these decisions, and on what grounds? When paid messages are not delivered, are senders refunded? Who receives or retains the money?

We demand clear explanations, disclosure of the refund policy and financial arrangements, and accountability for undelivered messages.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kent Hoover, a citizen of Tennessee, in coordination with Donald R. Askew Jr..

title: Records related to DHS CVE Grant EMW-2016-CA-APP-00285 (America Abroad Media) (Department of Homeland Security)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Dear FOIA Officer,

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), 5 U.S.C. § 552, I am requesting access to records regarding the Countering Violent Extremism (CVE) grant awarded to America Abroad Media (AAM) for the project titled "The Disrupters" (Application Number: EMW-2016-CA-APP-00285; Funding Opportunity Number: DHS-16-OCP-132-00-01).

I am a journalist and legal advocate researching the government's role in shaping media narratives related to Muslim American communities. This request is in the public interest as it pertains to the expenditure of public funds on messaging campaigns.

I request the following records for the period from January 1, 2016, to December 31, 2018:

Final Grant Agreement: The final negotiated grant agreement, including any statements of work, deliverables, and terms regarding content approval or review.

Reporting Documents: All progress reports, final performance reports, and financial reports submitted by America Abroad Media to DHS/OCP.

Content Review & Approval: All communications (emails, memos, meeting notes) between DHS/OCP staff and representatives of America Abroad Media, Affinis Labs, or RL Leaders discussing the development, review, or approval of any content, scripts, social media campaigns, or hackathon projects produced under this grant.

Government-Funded Content: Copies of, or links to, any content (videos, social media posts, workshop materials, hackathon pitches, etc.) created by America Abroad Media or its partners that were funded by this grant.

Partnership Records: Records showing the roles and responsibilities of sub-grantees or partners, including Affinis Labs and RL Leaders.

Communications with Community Groups: Communications between DHS/OCP and any local community partners in New York City, Minneapolis, or Los Angeles involved in the hackathons.

Fee Waiver Request:
I request a waiver of all search, review, and duplication fees as I am a representative of the news media, and the disclosure of the requested information is in the public interest because it is likely to contribute significantly to public understanding of the operations and activities of the government.

Format:
I prefer to receive the records in an electronic format.

Thank you for your prompt consideration of this request.

Sincerely,
Sanaa Ansari Khan

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Sanaa

title: A World with Commodity Nuclear Weapons

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: A World with Commodity Nuclear Weapons
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

The study "A World with Commodity Nuclear Weapons," completed in 2013 by the Office of Net Assessments. The existence of this study has been reported by the journalist Sharon Weinberger, who mentions on page 8 of her recent book,"Valley of Death" that the contents study were labeled sensitive but unclassified. Weinberger also reported on the study in the following Wall Street Journal article: https://www.wsj.com/business/could-a-rogue-billionaire-make-a-nuclear-weapon-cd8bfde2

For anything withheld, please cite the exemption for each redaction. For classified material, please give the classification level, the classification authority and the declassification date. Please release all pages, even heavily redacted ones, with administrative markings and pagination intact.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
